news.h: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice files for bankruptcy, claims he owes over $3.45M in debts
news.d: Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice filed for bankruptcy in federal court, claiming he has more than $3.45 million in debts.

news.h: Chiefs get Rashee Rice back from injury for Broncos game
news.d: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice is expected back from a hamstring injury against the Broncos on Sunday.
